title: +*RELIGIONS OF THE WORLD
description: Introduces students to the academic study of religion through reading the work of scholars who have theorized about the nature of religion and scholars who have done various types of hands-on research about religious phenomena. Explores a number of the world's major traditions. CROSSLISTED as PHL 160/REL 160.
